blocks.text: DSPM regularly scans the data stores of the target accounts by leveraging the orchestrator template deployed in the AWS orchestrator account while onboarding.

After onboarding an organization, you can change the orchestrator account if the existing orchestrator account is being decommissioned, deleted, or if an incorrect account was selected while onboarding. When you change the orchestrator account, you must run the orchestrator template in the new account. DSPM validates the template deployment and updates the orchestrator status accordingly.
This option is available only for AWS accounts onboarded through Zscaler network configuration mode.
Until the new orchestrator account is successfully validated, the following changes occur:

blocks.item: The DSPM connection status moves to the Waiting for Connection state and Configuration status moves to the Pending state.
The target accounts move to the Needs Attention state.

blocks.text: You must be assigned either an administrator role or a custom role with the Configure New Orchestrator permission in the Zscaler Admin Console.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > Cloud Accounts.
On the Cloud Accounts page, select the organization for which you want to change the orchestrator account.
Click Manage and then select Configure New Orchestrator.
In the Configure New Orchestrator window, read the caution and then select the I understand checkbox.
In the Configure an Orchestrator Account page, select the account and primary region where you want to deploy the orchestrator template, and then click Next.
The existing orchestrator account checkbox is disabled.
In the Provide Permissions page, download and run the templates.

Before running the template on the new orchestrator account, purge the template that was previously deployed on the existing orchestrator account. You can do this by deleting the corresponding stackset or running the terraform destroy command based on the template type.

blocks.text: DSPM validates the template deployment every hour by checking the roles created and permissions granted.
If there is any issue while deploying the template, an error is displayed. Rerun the templates in the orchestrator account and target accounts.

After the template deployment is validated successfully, the target accounts move to the Successfully Configured state, and DSPM begins the data scan. The orchestrator status (DSPM Connection and Configuration Status) moves to the Successful state.
You can view the orchestrator details on the Overview tab.
